pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are multi-sided polygons with smooth to slightly rounded edge transitions. Flank patches exhibit larger surface area and more complex geometry compared to the smaller, more uniform patches on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of light pelage with consistent pixel thickness across the flank. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, forming a continuous topological graph without visible breaks.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D silhouette of the mane along the upper cervical region shows high-frequency serration with low vertical amplitude.
